item.content:encoded:
You can get away with pop culture reference joke SCPs if the target audience is largely familiar with the material, the jokes are good, and it's clever. It's almost exactly the same as it is with other joke SCPs, honestly.

As near as I can tell, pop culture references got a bad name around the mass edit (or perhaps a bit before it), where a lot of pop culture joke SCPs were deleted for being mediocre. I don't see a compelling reason to be against them carte blanche nowadays, when the site can usually be trusted to perform quality control.

If this one in particular doesn't live up to your standards, that's totally understandable (I'm rather ambivalent on it myself), but "it's just a pop culture reference" isn't a very strong argument in my eyes.
